title: The Good Samaritan Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Good Samaritan Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Good Samaritan Bible crossword: the road to Jericho, the priest and the Levite, oil and wine and an inn. KJV-rooted clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: A lawyer asks who counts as a neighbour and gets a story instead of a definition. A man goes down from Jerusalem to Jericho and falls among thieves; two men who should stop don't; the one nobody expected does. The Good Samaritan turns Luke 10 into a grid — the road, the priest, the Levite, the oil and wine poured into the wounds, the two pence left with the host.

Parables make particularly good crosswords, because the details are the argument: it matters that it was a Samaritan, and it matters that he paid. Finish the grid and the puzzle closes on the verse the whole parable was told to answer.

clues.text: City the wounded man was travelling down to
First to see him and pass by on the other side
Poured into his wounds, with wine
Where the Samaritan brought him to be cared for

verseText: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
